entities.name: Franco-Prussian War
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: War between France and Prussia (1870–1871) that resulted in the unification of Germany under Prussian leadership, the fall of Napoleon III, and the loss of Alsace-Lorraine by France. The defeat planted seeds of revanchism that contributed to WWI.
